@metadata.description: Notes for translators: where each text of the card shows and what its placeholders hold. This is not a language.

search: Placeholder text in the empty search box at the top of the card.
clear: Label of the button that clears the search box. Screen readers say it.
channels: Heading above the channels found by a search.
onNow: Heading above the programmes on air now, found by a search.
later: Heading above the programmes later today or on the next days, found by a search.
searching: Shows while a search step is still running.
loading: Shows while the channel list or the schedule of a day is loading.
noMatch: Shows when a search finds nothing. {query} is the text the user typed.
noGuide: Short text in a channel row when the guide has no programmes for the channel.
noGuideLong: Text in the channel details when the guide has no programmes for the channel.
notSelected: Short text in a channel row when the channel is in the card, but not selected in the integration.
notSelectedLong: Text in the channel details when the channel is not selected in the integration. It tells the user where to fix it.
until: End time of the programme on air now, in a row. {time} is a time, such as 19:55.
left: Time left of the programme on air now. {duration} is the text of the "hours" or "minutes" key.
in: Time until a programme starts today. {duration} is the text of the "hours" or "minutes" key.
ended: Shows on a programme that has ended.
hours: A duration of one hour or more. {hours} and {minutes} are whole numbers. Used inside "left" and "in".
minutes: A duration under one hour. {minutes} is a whole number. Used inside "left" and "in".
today: Day chip for today in the channel schedule.
tomorrow: Day chip for tomorrow in the channel schedule.
switchTo: Button that switches the TV to the channel. {channel_number} is the channel number on the box, such as 5 or 5.1.
switching: Short message while the TV switches. {channel_number} is the channel number, {channel_name} is the channel name.
moreAirings: Heading of the list of other airings of the same programme, in the programme details.
showAll: Button that shows all other airings in a group. {count} is how many there are, always more than 3.
onChannel: Heading of the other airings on the same channel. {channel_name} is the channel name.
onOtherChannels: Heading of the other airings on the other channels of the card.
close: Label of the button that closes the details sheet. Screen readers say it.
back: Label of the button that goes from the programme details back to the channel schedule. Screen readers say it.
details: Label of a row that opens its details. Screen readers say it. {name} is the channel name or the programme title.
day: Label of the row of day chips. Screen readers say it.
sheet: Label of the details sheet. Screen readers say it.
notLoaded: Shows instead of the list until the integration has downloaded the guide once.
notSetUp: Shows instead of the list when the TV guide integration is not added in Home Assistant.
loadFailed: Shows when the card cannot get the guide from Home Assistant. The card tries again by itself.
cardDescription: Description in the card picker of the dashboard editor.
staleGuide: Notice above the list when the last good download is old. {date_time} is a day and a time, such as 17 Oct, 12:30.
switchFailed: Error message when the switch action fails. {channel_name} is the channel name, {error} is the error text from Home Assistant, in English.
remindMe: Label of the bell button in the programme details. It sets a reminder that sends a phone notification 5 minutes before the programme starts. Screen readers say it. Shows while no reminder is set.
reminderSet: Label of the bell button in the programme details while a reminder is set, and label of the small bell under the time of a programme in the channel schedule. Screen readers say it.
noPhone: Warning in the programme details, under the time, when a reminder is set but Home Assistant knows no phone with the Home Assistant app for the user. The reminder still works for automations, but no notification is sent.
reminderFailed: Error message when setting or removing a reminder fails. {error} is the error text from Home Assistant, in English.
reminderTooLate: Toast shown when a reminder cannot be set because the programme starts too soon (in less than 5 minutes).
